request.instructions:
1. Follow this procedure exactly.

2. 1. READ. Read the task statement, target file, visible tests, and every docstring. Treat each documented behavior and edge case as a requirement.
3. DIAGNOSE. Name the single root cause: one wrong expression, one
   missing case, one wrong boundary. If you cannot name it, say so and
   make the most conservative change consistent with the statement.
4. 2. DIAGNOSE. Compare every function with its docstring and tests; identify all mismatches, including boundaries and interactions.
5. 3. FIX. Make the smallest changes that correct all identified mismatches. Preserve public names and signatures; avoid unrelated refactoring or features.
6. 4. CHECK. Verify each function against its docstring, visible tests, and relevant boundary cases.

Output contract: exactly one fenced block (```python ... ```) containing
the complete corrected target file. Nothing outside the block is read.
